from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
REPO = next(path for path in (Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents)
            if (path / "reported_runs/analysis/appendix_epoch_budget.py").is_file())
if str(REPO) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))
from IPython.display import display
from reported_runs.analysis.appendix_epoch_budget import (
    load_epoch_budget, epoch_budget_plot, epoch_budget_summary, export_epoch_budget,
)
get_ipython().run_line_magic("matplotlib", "inline")
